writingRules: Short sentences, mostly under 20 words; paragraphs of 2-4 sentences.
Answer the search intent in the first 1-2 paragraphs, then reassure.
Give readers a short bolded formula they can remember.
Humor lives in slogans, examples and captions, never in safety advice or factual event information.
When a joke is edgier, pair it with audience advice.
Culture and Occasions close on a light reflection; How To, Lifestyle and Fashion close on one actionable takeaway, then the FAQ.

rules: Primary keyword within the first 60 characters; SEO title <= 60 characters.
Use exact counts and make the body deliver that count.
Add the year only to trend- or season-driven topics, and refresh it yearly.
Approved qualifiers: personal, useful, thoughtful, practical, for every..., actually (max once per headline set).

skeleton: Intro of 2 short paragraphs: answer the intent, then reassure
Optional 'At a Glance' / 'Before You ...' callout table
H2s by theme or style; numbered H3 entries with a repeated template
'How to Choose' and/or 'What Not to Buy / Avoid' section
One closing takeaway line or short reflection (no generic recap)
FAQ: H3 questions, bold one-sentence answer, then detail
Author box + 'See my guides' / 'Join our Community'

formatting.images: Every image has a tip-adding caption and descriptive alt text
formatting.tables: Comparisons (budget, recipient, trip type) with a 'Why it matters' or 'What to consider' column

authors.name: Marcus V.
authors.expertise: 10+ years in personalized apparel: fabrics, sizing, trends

commerce.principle: Products follow the advice; they never replace it. Product blocks appear only after the guidance they illustrate.
commerce.thirdPartyBrands: Allowed when genuinely helpful, always with compatibility caveats
commerce.priceDisclaimer: These are general shopping ranges, not verified current prices.

editorialStandards.sources: Prefer official PYW product and policy pages, official holiday or event sites, reputable publications; cite inline at the claim.
editorialStandards.aiUse: Allowed for ideas, outlines, drafts, headings, internal links; human review required before publishing.
editorialStandards.sourceOfTruth: The store, for price, availability and policies; time-sensitive details must never read as permanent.
editorialStandards.disclosure: Disclose affiliate or sponsored relationships where they exist.
editorialStandards.qualityClaims: No 'premium cotton', 'made in USA' or similar unless the product page states it.
editorialStandards.corrections: Report an Issue page or support@printyourwear.com

sensitiveTopics.dont: Use grief as a sales hook
Stereotypes, flattening a culture into one image

microcopy: Don't know much about X? No problem.
Start with the name, add one memory, then close with a hope.
Does this sound like something I would actually say?
Pack for the route, not just the destination.

prePublishChecklist: Article sits in the right category per categoryBoundaries and links to its cluster siblings
Headline uses an approved pattern; SEO title <= 60 characters with the keyword up front
Intro answers the intent in 2 short paragraphs, then reassures
Tone matches the category level; humor stays in slogans, examples and captions
Listicle count in the headline equals the count in the body
Product blocks only follow related guidance; commerce intensity matches the category
Every store link carries the blog UTM parameters
Prices shown as ranges with a disclaimer; no unverified material or origin claims
Facts, dates and statistics checked against official or reputable sources and linked inline
FAQ, image captions and alt text present; only 💡 and 📌 callouts
Author matches the category; human review done on any AI-assisted draft
